_doc: Named storage events for scripts/ops/storage_rates.py. A step is a measured one-off (a batch) removed from every later sample so it is not charged again per day. A transient is a rise that recovered; its samples can be excluded from the stress rate by name. Add an entry only with evidence; the as-observed rate is always reported too.
